CREATE TABLE event_inbox (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	source_event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	processed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	handler_result JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_event_inbox_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processed', 'rejected'))
)

CREATE TABLE runs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	connection_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	repository_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	subject_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	subject_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	subject_key VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	failed_handler VARCHAR(32), 
	reason VARCHAR(300), 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent_run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	attempt INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_generation INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	cancel_requested BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','planning','awaiting_approval','running','publishing','verifying','reviewing','ready_for_human','blocked','failed','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_provider CHECK (provider IN ('github','gitlab')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_counters CHECK (attempt > 0 AND generation > 0 AND cancellation_generation >= 0 AND version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_subject_kind CHECK (subject_kind IN ('issue','review')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE schema_installation (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	installation_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	baseline_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	archive_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	backup_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	installed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_schema_installation_singleton CHECK (id = 1), 
	UNIQUE (installation_id)
)

CREATE TABLE approved_inputs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	predecessor_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	spec_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_approved_revision UNIQUE (run_id, revision), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_approved_revision CHECK (revision > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE budget_pools (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	usd NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	calls BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	state_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pool_purpose UNIQUE (run_id, purpose), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pool_capacity CHECK (usd >= 0 AND calls >= 0 AND tokens >= 0 AND version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pool_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('implementation','closing')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE candidates (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	approved_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL, 
	validation_json TEXT, 
	published_sha VARCHAR(64), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_candidate_dispatch UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_candidate_state CHECK (state IN ('received','validated','refused','published')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE checkpoints (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	approved_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	driver VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	retained BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_checkpoint_identity UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation, digest), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE commands (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'accepted' NOT NULL, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	reply_json TEXT, 
	due_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '3' NOT NULL, 
	lease_epoch INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(200), 
	lease_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_command_state CHECK (state IN ('accepted','running','resolved','completed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_command_counts CHECK (lease_epoch >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND max_attempts > 0), 
	UNIQUE (source_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE control_commands (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	world_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	delivery_json TEXT, 
	acknowledgement_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_control_key UNIQUE (run_id, command_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_control_sequence UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_control_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','inflight','acknowledged','refused','expired')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE gateway_keys (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	alias VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'implementation' NOT NULL, 
	reference_json TEXT, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ciphertext BYTEA, 
	token_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	aad_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'reserved' NOT NULL, 
	block_effect_key VARCHAR(300), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_key_dispatch UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation, purpose), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_key_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','active','unknown','blocked','purged')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_key_purged CHECK (state <> 'purged' OR ciphertext IS NULL), 
	UNIQUE (alias), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE lane_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nonce_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	nonce_consumed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	dispatch_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	brief_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	provider_binding_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	first_job_json TEXT, 
	api_state_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_session_dispatch UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_session_counters CHECK (attempt > 0 AND generation > 0 AND cancellation_generation >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (nonce_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_cursors (
	root_review_ref VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	review_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_reviewed_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (root_review_ref), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_cursor_version CHECK (version > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_rounds (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	child_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_review_ref VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	feedback_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_round_feedback UNIQUE (root_run_id, feedback_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_round_state CHECK (state IN ('open','closed','refused')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	UNIQUE (child_run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(child_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_specs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_spec_run UNIQUE (run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE steps (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	handler VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'scheduled' NOT NULL, 
	due_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '3' NOT NULL, 
	lease_epoch INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(200), 
	lease_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_state CHECK (state IN ('scheduled','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled','dead')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_counts CHECK (attempts >= 0 AND max_attempts > 0 AND lease_epoch >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_handler CHECK (handler IN ('plan','approve','dispatch','await_lane','publish','verify','review','ready','feedback_review')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_lease CHECK ((state = 'running' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR state <> 'running'), 
	UNIQUE (key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE usage (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	alias VARCHAR(200), 
	completeness VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	final BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	usd NUMERIC(38, 18), 
	calls BIGINT, 
	tokens BIGINT, 
	receipt_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	conflict_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_usage_source UNIQUE (source_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_usage_completeness CHECK (completeness IN ('exact','aggregate','partial','unknown','unmetered')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_usage_nonnegative CHECK ((usd IS NULL OR usd >= 0) AND (calls IS NULL OR calls >= 0) AND (tokens IS NULL OR tokens >= 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE blobs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	storage_ref VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_id VARCHAR(64), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_blob_authorization UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation, digest), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_blob_size CHECK (size >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(checkpoint_id) REFERENCES checkpoints (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE budget_amendments (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pool_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	amount_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	gateway_effect_key VARCHAR(300), 
	reservation_key VARCHAR(300), 
	target_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_amendment_command UNIQUE (run_id, command_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_amendment_state CHECK (state IN ('authorized','applied','refused','unknown')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pool_id) REFERENCES budget_pools (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pool_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reservation_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	requested_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	minimum_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	allowance_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	observed_usd NUMERIC(38, 18), 
	observed_calls BIGINT, 
	observed_tokens BIGINT, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_reservation_key UNIQUE (pool_id, reservation_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reservation_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','accrued','unknown','settled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pool_id) REFERENCES budget_pools (id)
)

CREATE TABLE effects (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	step_id VARCHAR(32), 
	command_id VARCHAR(32), 
	lease_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'requested' NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	outcome_json TEXT, 
	observations_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	repo_key VARCHAR(400), 
	head_branch VARCHAR(255), 
	dispatch_nonce_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	dispatched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	dispatch_deadline_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_owner CHECK ((step_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND command_id IS NULL) OR (step_id IS NULL AND command_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_state CHECK (state IN ('requested','dispatched','committed','adopted','conflict','failed','unknown')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_counters CHECK (version > 0 AND lease_epoch > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_draft_identity CHECK (kind <> 'ensure_draft' OR (repo_key IS NOT NULL AND head_branch IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_dispatch_nonce CHECK ((kind = 'dispatch_lane' AND dispatch_nonce_digest IS NOT NULL) OR (kind <> 'dispatch_lane' AND dispatch_nonce_digest IS NULL)), 
	UNIQUE (key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(step_id) REFERENCES steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES commands (id)
)

CREATE TABLE gates (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	decision_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'prepared' NOT NULL, 
	approved_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	consumed_by VARCHAR(200), 
	consumed_step_id VARCHAR(32), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_gate_decision UNIQUE (run_id, decision_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_gate_state CHECK (state IN ('prepared','open','consumed','expired','refused')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_gate_consuming_step FOREIGN KEY(consumed_step_id) REFERENCES steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE reactive_reviews (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_review_ref VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	head_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	policy_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	input_json TEXT, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	state VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'accepted' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_reactive_review_head UNIQUE (root_review_ref, head_sha), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reactive_review_state CHECK (state IN ('accepted','model_requested','model_completed','commented','stale')), 
	UNIQUE (run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_review_ref) REFERENCES review_cursors (root_review_ref)
)

CREATE TABLE step_timings (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	step_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	lease_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	handler VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_step_timing_epoch UNIQUE (step_id, lease_epoch), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_timing_bound CHECK (lease_epoch > 0 AND seconds >= 0 AND seconds <= 86400), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_timing_outcome CHECK (outcome IN ('completed','parked','rescheduled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(step_id) REFERENCES steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_event_inbox_source_event_id ON event_inbox (source_event_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_runs_subject_key ON runs (subject_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_subject ON runs (subject_key) WHERE state NOT IN ('ready_for_human', 'blocked', 'failed', 'cancelled')
CREATE INDEX ix_approved_inputs_run_id ON approved_inputs (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_budget_pools_run_id ON budget_pools (run_id)

CREATE INDEX ix_commands_due ON commands (state, due_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_commands_run_id ON commands (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_control_commands_run_id ON control_commands (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_gateway_keys_run_id ON gateway_keys (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_lane_sessions_run_id ON lane_sessions (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_review_cursors_root_run_id ON review_cursors (root_run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_review_rounds_run_id ON review_rounds (run_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_round_slot ON review_rounds (root_review_ref) WHERE state = 'open'
CREATE INDEX ix_run_specs_run_id ON run_specs (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_steps_due ON steps (state, due_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_steps_run_id ON steps (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_usage_run_id ON usage (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_blobs_digest ON blobs (digest)
CREATE INDEX ix_blobs_run_id ON blobs (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_budget_amendments_run_id ON budget_amendments (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_budget_reservations_pool_id ON budget_reservations (pool_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_effect_unresolved ON effects (state, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_effects_command_id ON effects (command_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_effects_run_id ON effects (run_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_effect_dispatch_nonce ON effects (dispatch_nonce_digest)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_effect_draft ON effects (repo_key, head_branch) WHERE kind = 'ensure_draft'

CREATE INDEX ix_step_timings_run_id ON step_timings (run_id)

CREATE TABLE event_inbox (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	processed_at DATETIME, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	handler_result JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_event_inbox_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processed', 'rejected'))
)

CREATE TABLE runs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	connection_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	repository_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	subject_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	subject_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	subject_key VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	failed_handler VARCHAR(32), 
	reason VARCHAR(300), 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent_run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	attempt INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_generation INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	cancel_requested BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_state CHECK (state IN ('queued','planning','awaiting_approval','running','publishing','verifying','reviewing','ready_for_human','blocked','failed','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_provider CHECK (provider IN ('github','gitlab')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_counters CHECK (attempt > 0 AND generation > 0 AND cancellation_generation >= 0 AND version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_run_subject_kind CHECK (subject_kind IN ('issue','review')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE schema_installation (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	installation_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	baseline_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	archive_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	backup_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	installed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_schema_installation_singleton CHECK (id = 1), 
	UNIQUE (installation_id)
)

CREATE TABLE approved_inputs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	predecessor_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	spec_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_approved_revision UNIQUE (run_id, revision), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_approved_revision CHECK (revision > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE budget_pools (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	usd TEXT NOT NULL, 
	calls BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	state_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pool_purpose UNIQUE (run_id, purpose), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pool_capacity CHECK (usd >= 0 AND calls >= 0 AND tokens >= 0 AND version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pool_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('implementation','closing')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE candidates (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	approved_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL, 
	validation_json TEXT, 
	published_sha VARCHAR(64), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_candidate_dispatch UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_candidate_state CHECK (state IN ('received','validated','refused','published')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE checkpoints (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	approved_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	driver VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	retained BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_checkpoint_identity UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation, digest), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE commands (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'accepted' NOT NULL, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	reply_json TEXT, 
	due_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '3' NOT NULL, 
	lease_epoch INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(200), 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_command_state CHECK (state IN ('accepted','running','resolved','completed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_command_counts CHECK (lease_epoch >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND max_attempts > 0), 
	UNIQUE (source_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE control_commands (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	world_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	delivery_json TEXT, 
	acknowledgement_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_control_key UNIQUE (run_id, command_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_control_sequence UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_control_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','inflight','acknowledged','refused','expired')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE gateway_keys (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	alias VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'implementation' NOT NULL, 
	reference_json TEXT, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ciphertext BLOB, 
	token_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	aad_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'reserved' NOT NULL, 
	block_effect_key VARCHAR(300), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_key_dispatch UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation, purpose), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_key_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','active','unknown','blocked','purged')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_key_purged CHECK (state <> 'purged' OR ciphertext IS NULL), 
	UNIQUE (alias), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE lane_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nonce_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	nonce_consumed BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	dispatch_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	brief_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	provider_binding_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	first_job_json TEXT, 
	api_state_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_session_dispatch UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_session_counters CHECK (attempt > 0 AND generation > 0 AND cancellation_generation >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (nonce_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_cursors (
	root_review_ref VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	review_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_reviewed_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (root_review_ref), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_cursor_version CHECK (version > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_rounds (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	child_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_review_ref VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	feedback_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_round_feedback UNIQUE (root_run_id, feedback_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_round_state CHECK (state IN ('open','closed','refused')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	UNIQUE (child_run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(child_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_specs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_spec_run UNIQUE (run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE steps (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	handler VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'scheduled' NOT NULL, 
	due_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at DATETIME, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '3' NOT NULL, 
	lease_epoch INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(200), 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_state CHECK (state IN ('scheduled','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled','dead')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_counts CHECK (attempts >= 0 AND max_attempts > 0 AND lease_epoch >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_handler CHECK (handler IN ('plan','approve','dispatch','await_lane','publish','verify','review','ready','feedback_review')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_lease CHECK ((state = 'running' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR state <> 'running'), 
	UNIQUE ("key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE usage (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	alias VARCHAR(200), 
	completeness VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	final BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	usd TEXT, 
	calls BIGINT, 
	tokens BIGINT, 
	receipt_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	conflict_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_usage_source UNIQUE (source_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_usage_completeness CHECK (completeness IN ('exact','aggregate','partial','unknown','unmetered')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_usage_nonnegative CHECK ((usd IS NULL OR usd >= 0) AND (calls IS NULL OR calls >= 0) AND (tokens IS NULL OR tokens >= 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE blobs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	storage_ref VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_id VARCHAR(64), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_blob_authorization UNIQUE (run_id, attempt, generation, digest), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_blob_size CHECK (size >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(checkpoint_id) REFERENCES checkpoints (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE budget_amendments (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pool_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	amount_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	gateway_effect_key VARCHAR(300), 
	reservation_key VARCHAR(300), 
	target_json TEXT, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_amendment_command UNIQUE (run_id, command_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_amendment_state CHECK (state IN ('authorized','applied','refused','unknown')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pool_id) REFERENCES budget_pools (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	pool_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reservation_key VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	requested_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	minimum_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	allowance_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	observed_usd TEXT, 
	observed_calls BIGINT, 
	observed_tokens BIGINT, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_reservation_key UNIQUE (pool_id, reservation_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reservation_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','accrued','unknown','settled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pool_id) REFERENCES budget_pools (id)
)

CREATE TABLE effects (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	step_id VARCHAR(32), 
	command_id VARCHAR(32), 
	lease_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'requested' NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	outcome_json TEXT, 
	observations_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	repo_key VARCHAR(400), 
	head_branch VARCHAR(255), 
	dispatch_nonce_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	dispatched_at DATETIME, 
	dispatch_deadline_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_owner CHECK ((step_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND command_id IS NULL) OR (step_id IS NULL AND command_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_state CHECK (state IN ('requested','dispatched','committed','adopted','conflict','failed','unknown')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_counters CHECK (version > 0 AND lease_epoch > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_draft_identity CHECK (kind <> 'ensure_draft' OR (repo_key IS NOT NULL AND head_branch IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_effect_dispatch_nonce CHECK ((kind = 'dispatch_lane' AND dispatch_nonce_digest IS NOT NULL) OR (kind <> 'dispatch_lane' AND dispatch_nonce_digest IS NULL)), 
	UNIQUE ("key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(step_id) REFERENCES steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES commands (id)
)

CREATE TABLE gates (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	decision_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'prepared' NOT NULL, 
	approved_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at DATETIME, 
	consumed_by VARCHAR(200), 
	consumed_step_id VARCHAR(32), 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_gate_decision UNIQUE (run_id, decision_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_gate_state CHECK (state IN ('prepared','open','consumed','expired','refused')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_gate_consuming_step FOREIGN KEY(consumed_step_id) REFERENCES steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE reactive_reviews (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	root_run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_review_ref VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	base_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	head_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	policy_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	input_json TEXT, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	state VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'accepted' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_reactive_review_head UNIQUE (root_review_ref, head_sha), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reactive_review_state CHECK (state IN ('accepted','model_requested','model_completed','commented','stale')), 
	UNIQUE (run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id) REFERENCES runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_review_ref) REFERENCES review_cursors (root_review_ref)
)

CREATE TABLE step_timings (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	step_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	lease_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	handler VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_step_timing_epoch UNIQUE (step_id, lease_epoch), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_timing_bound CHECK (lease_epoch > 0 AND seconds >= 0 AND seconds <= 86400), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_timing_outcome CHECK (outcome IN ('completed','parked','rescheduled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(step_id) REFERENCES steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_event_inbox_project_id ON event_inbox (project_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_event_inbox_source_event_id ON event_inbox (source_event_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_runs_subject_key ON runs (subject_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_subject ON runs (subject_key) WHERE state NOT IN ('ready_for_human', 'blocked', 'failed', 'cancelled')
CREATE INDEX ix_approved_inputs_run_id ON approved_inputs (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_budget_pools_run_id ON budget_pools (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_candidates_run_id ON candidates (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_checkpoints_run_id ON checkpoints (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_commands_due ON commands (state, due_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_commands_run_id ON commands (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_control_commands_run_id ON control_commands (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_gateway_keys_run_id ON gateway_keys (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_lane_sessions_run_id ON lane_sessions (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_review_cursors_root_run_id ON review_cursors (root_run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_review_rounds_run_id ON review_rounds (run_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_round_slot ON review_rounds (root_review_ref) WHERE state = 'open'
CREATE INDEX ix_run_specs_run_id ON run_specs (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_steps_due ON steps (state, due_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_steps_run_id ON steps (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_usage_run_id ON usage (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_blobs_digest ON blobs (digest)
CREATE INDEX ix_blobs_run_id ON blobs (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_budget_amendments_run_id ON budget_amendments (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_budget_reservations_pool_id ON budget_reservations (pool_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_effect_unresolved ON effects (state, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_effects_command_id ON effects (command_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_effects_run_id ON effects (run_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_effect_dispatch_nonce ON effects (dispatch_nonce_digest)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_effect_draft ON effects (repo_key, head_branch) WHERE kind = 'ensure_draft'
CREATE INDEX ix_gates_run_id ON gates (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_reactive_reviews_root_review_ref ON reactive_reviews (root_review_ref)
CREATE INDEX ix_reactive_reviews_root_run_id ON reactive_reviews (root_run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_step_timings_run_id ON step_timings (run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_step_timings_step_id ON step_timings (step_id)

checks.name: ck_pool_capacity
checks.sqltext: usd >= 0 AND calls >= 0 AND tokens >= 0 AND version > 0

checks.name: ck_effect_dispatch_nonce
checks.sqltext: (kind = 'dispatch_lane' AND dispatch_nonce_digest IS NOT NULL) OR (kind <> 'dispatch_lane' AND dispatch_nonce_digest IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_effect_draft_identity
checks.sqltext: kind <> 'ensure_draft' OR (repo_key IS NOT NULL AND head_branch IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_effect_owner
checks.sqltext: (step_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND command_id IS NULL) OR (step_id IS NULL AND command_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_run_counters
checks.sqltext: attempt > 0 AND generation > 0 AND cancellation_generation >= 0 AND version > 0

checks.name: ck_step_lease
checks.sqltext: (state = 'running' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR state <> 'running'

checks.name: ck_usage_nonnegative
checks.sqltext: (usd IS NULL OR usd >= 0) AND (calls IS NULL OR calls >= 0) AND (tokens IS NULL OR tokens >= 0)
